error-bound.def: A number that the size of an error cannot exceed: if $E$ is an error bound for an approximation, then $|\text{actual} - \text{approximation}| \le E$.

alternating-error-bound.def: For an alternating series whose sizes $a_n$ decrease to 0, the error of the partial sum $S_n$ is at most the first omitted term: $|S - S_n| \le a_{n+1}$.
